values.MACE_PARTITION: Slurm partition MACE training and replay selection run in (a GPU partition)
values.MACE_GPUS_PER_NODE: GPUs per node there; launch_plan takes gpus from 1 to this, one node per job
values.MACE_CORES_PER_GPU: cores that come with (and are billed for) one GPU
values.MACE_WORK_DIR: where fine-tuning run folders go on the cluster
values.MACE_MODELS: foundation models installed on the cluster: name -> {model (path), sha256, source (URL), theory, heads, r_max, dtype, replay: {path | null, source}, lammps: {precision: exported metatomic file}}
values.MACE_LAUNCH: launch_plan's job-spec templates: {pre_launch, launcher, environment}, with {G} GPUs (= processes), {T} cores per process, {env_script} and other values by name
